{{Top|leg}}
An '''aphren''' was a tiny insect. Aphrens did not respond to normal extermination methods. They had a strange habit of humming at seemingly random intervals. Aphrens were very similar to [[skronkie]]s and [[metalmite]]s.<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
